count: How many energy cells are there?
compare: Which group has more energy cells? Enter the larger number.
count-hint: Touch each cell once as you count.
compare-hint: Count each group. Choose the number that is larger.
add-hint: Start with the first number and count on.
subtract-hint: Start with the first number and count back.
missing-hint: Count up from the first number to the total.
compose: How many energy cells are in both groups altogether?
compose-hint: Count the first group, then count on through the second group.
decompose-hint: Count the starting cells. Remove the cells taken away. Count what is left.
